On 9/14/20 4:31 PM, fay ta wrote:
> The variables are treated as they actually are, but I dont know whether
> the option "PML" is used for both of them, as it was stated in a
> respective tutorial that "lavaan code for the PML has not yet been
> written to cover the more general case".

I just checked, and PML works with both continuous and ordered
(dependent) variables.

At least when there are no exogenous covariates involved. If that would
be the case, you must (explicitly) treat them as random, by stating
conditional.x = FALSE and fixed = FALSE.

If it doesn't work (for you), please send me the data and a short R script.

Yves.
